title: Zapier Team to self-hosted Windmill
summary: Windmill is automation for people who would rather write a function than drag a box. That suits some teams and rules out others.

you_lose: Zapier's catalogue of prebuilt integrations, which is the actual product
Non-technical colleagues being able to build their own workflows
Someone else fixing an integration when a vendor changes their API
you_gain: Scripts in TypeScript, Python, Go or Bash with proper version control
Genuinely fast execution — this is a Rust runtime, not a hosted queue
Unmetered runs, which is the whole argument

caveats: This is the least like-for-like swap on the site. If the people building your automations are not programmers, Windmill is not a Zapier replacement and the arithmetic is beside the point.
The 14-hour estimate assumes you are comfortable writing the integrations yourself. There is no importer.
Windmill's licence is not one GitHub recognises automatically, and some features are enterprise-gated. Check before committing.
